title: Delta-driven prompt regression CI hook with per-prompt SLO gating
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Existing eval CI gates operate on global delta thresholds (avg accuracy or aggregate score) which miss signal from small-but-critical prompt regressions and cause noisy failures from flaky prompts. This PR introduces a delta-driven CI hook that evaluates per-prompt metric deltas against configurable SLOs and makes gated decisions with two outcomes: 1) fail CI for systemic regressions (aggregated SLO breach), and 2) open actionable alerts for targeted prompt regressions without failing the whole pipeline (soft alerts). This reduces noisy red builds while ensuring high‑priority prompt regressions are surfaced.

Design summary: single new CI hook binary (prompt_delta_gate) that ingests baseline eval artifacts (previous successful run) and current run results (JSONL prompt-level metrics). It computes for each prompt: delta = current_score - baseline_score, normalizes by baseline variance, and compares against per-prompt SLO definitions. The hook returns a non-zero exit only if the aggregated SLO breach score exceeds the pipeline threshold. Otherwise it emits structured diagnostics, uploads a condensed regression manifest to the artifacts bucket, and posts summarized findings to the configured alert sink (Slack/Sentry/Linear).

Key features:
- Per-prompt SLO config (yaml): allow per-prompt thresholds and severity tags.
- Baseline selection: supports select-by-tag (last-stable), specific run id, or time window.
- Aggregation policy: weighted-sum of violations, with weights driven by prompt importance and volume.
- Flakiness suppression: automatic jitter/flip detection to avoid alerting on single-run noise.
- Metrics integration: emits Prometheus metrics (eval_prompt_regressions_total, eval_regression_weighted_score) for dashboards and long-term trending.
- CI behavior: two modes - strict (fail on aggregate breach) and permissive (fail only when high-severity regressions are detected).

Sample per-prompt SLO config (illustrative):

slo_version: v1
global_threshold: 0.25 # weighted breach threshold to fail CI
prompts:
  - id: intent/confirm_email
    importance: 3
    delta_threshold: -0.05
    severity: high
  - id: info/faq_shipping_time
    importance: 1
    delta_threshold: -0.12
    severity: medium

CLI usage (examples):
- Run in CI comparing last-stable baseline: ./tools/prompt_delta_gate --baseline-tag last-stable --current results/2026-02-11.jsonl --config .ci/prompt_slos.yaml --mode strict
- Generate artifact only (do not fail): ./tools/prompt_delta_gate --baseline-id run-2026-02-10 --current results.jsonl --emit-artifact only

Backward compatibility: We keep the existing aggregate-score gate as a fallback and add the new hook to the eval CI workflow; teams can opt-in by adding a small config entry in their eval job template.

Security: The hook only reads eval artifact blobs and writes a small regression manifest to the configured artifacts bucket. No secrets are embedded; auth uses CI runner credentials.

Testing: Unit coverage for delta math and aggregation; integration test against synthetic eval artifacts (in tests/integration/test_delta_ci.py). Load-tested locally on 10k prompt runs to validate performance (median run < 6s for 10k prompts with simple metrics).

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Docs (ci/prompt-slo-gates.md)
- [x] Prometheus metric emitters
- [x] Add to .github workflow (eval-ci)

References: Linear ENG-4821 (prompt regression detection), ENG-5032 (ci gate UX), prior discussion: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4821/prompt-regression-detection

release_notes: Adds a delta-driven prompt-regression CI hook that enables per-prompt SLO gating and targeted alerting. Default behavior is permissive; teams can opt into strict failure mode. Emits Prometheus metrics for monitoring and uploads a regression manifest artifact for triage.
